scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "uv run --directory api uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload" "npm -w web run dev"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: uv run --directory api ruff check . && uv run --directory api ruff format --check . && npm -w web run lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory api pyright && npm -w web run typecheck
